query:
SELECT p.id as plant_id, p.name as plant_name, m.id as molecule_id, m.name as molecule_name
FROM plants p
CROSS JOIN molecules m
WHERE 
  (p.name = 'Gingembre' AND m.name IN ('Zingiberene', 'Gingerol', 'Beta-bisabolene', 'Alpha-curcumene'))
  OR (p.name = 'Sauge sclarée' AND m.name IN ('Linalyl acetate', 'Linalool', 'Sclareol', 'Germacrene D'))
  OR (p.name = 'Pin sylvestre' AND m.name IN ('Alpha-pinene', 'Beta-pinene', 'Delta-3-carene', 'Limonene'))
  OR (p.name = 'Tea tree' AND m.name IN ('Terpinen-4-ol', 'Gamma-terpinene', 'Alpha-terpinene', '1,8-Cineole'))
  OR (p.name = 'Cardamome' AND m.name IN ('1,8-Cineole', 'Alpha-terpinyl acetate', 'Linalool', 'Limonene'))
ORDER BY p.name, m.name;
